questions.prompt: An existing Uniform VM scale set must become Flexible. What must the administrator account for?

options.text: Orchestration mode cannot be changed in place; plan a supported migration or replacement.
options.explanation: The mode is selected when the scale set is created.

options.text: Changing the upgrade policy to Rolling changes orchestration mode.
options.explanation: Upgrade policy and orchestration mode are different settings.

options.text: Setting instance count to zero automatically converts it.
options.explanation: Capacity changes do not convert the resource mode.

options.text: Moving it to another resource group converts it to Flexible.
options.explanation: Resource-group moves do not change orchestration mode.

questions.prompt: A scale set uses Manual upgrade policy. Its model is updated to a new image, then a new instance is added. What is expected?

options.text: The new instance uses the new model; existing instances need an explicit update.
options.explanation: Manual policy separates model updates from updating existing instances.

options.text: Every existing instance updates immediately in guaranteed batches.
options.explanation: That behavior is not provided by Manual policy.

options.text: New instances always use the oldest image until all existing VMs are deleted.
options.explanation: New instances use the latest model.

options.text: The model update is ignored for both old and new instances.
options.explanation: The updated model governs subsequent instance creation.

questions.prompt: A VM scale set should add instances during sustained demand and later remove them. Which TWO configuration choices support this?

options.text: A scaling profile and autoscale rules with bounded instance counts
options.explanation: The profile defines new instances and the rules control count within limits.

options.text: Distinct scale-out and scale-in conditions with suitable cooldown
options.explanation: These govern both directions while limiting oscillation.

options.text: Only changing the VM SKU on one instance
options.explanation: That is a size change, not count-based demand scaling.

options.text: Setting a maximum count of one while expecting three instances
options.explanation: The configured maximum prevents scaling to three.
